summary: Maintain reconciliation and mail objective inputs by changed subject

schema.detail: Changed-key journals and reductions are process-local.

rules.detail: Desired roster rows, run projection fences and operational fault families retain unchanged reductions. Mail authority and source changes route to affected recipients and messages instead of invalidating the population.

compatibility.detail: Lifecycle and authority checks remain authoritative. Native coverage loss still requires complete reconstruction. Desired changed-subject retention is bounded; journal eviction forces stale consumers to rebuild from the live roster. Performance reports expose reconcile input and fault-family work counters.

recovery.detail: Schema or observer coverage changes fence retained reductions. Real eligibility deadlines continue to select affected subjects.
